data.title: Roofing company setup
data.description: Full setup draft for a roofing/exteriors company that sells retail replacements, works insurance claims, and runs repairs and maintenance: profile, lead intake, per-job-type sales workflows with job-specific contracts and payment terms, schedules & commissions, production templates, team, summary, and a data-import finale.

stages.notes: Standard identity and company creation; skipped by sandbox instances.
Shared production branding flow: website discovery, logo, palette, live previews.
Services, job types (drives the sales-workflow tabs), team size.
Lead sources, first-contact method, optional lead inbox + web form.
Guided per-job-type sales setup: contact strategy, follow-up cycle, bid timing, checklist, payment terms, and job-specific contract/proposal.
Conditional sales-appointment availability, duration, per-day hours, and recurring blocked times.
Per-job-type commission plans with same-as shortcuts, custom line items, and optional self-generated rules.
Per-job-type production to-do templates + crew payment model.
Office, sales, field, crews; skippable for solo operators.
Read-back, sending identity, SMS add-on recap.
'One more thing': contact CSV import + active jobs. Skippable.
